content.summary:
**Preparing for dataset analysis**

I need to use the dataset file named segmentation-all.csv. My plan is to run the relevant code to generate outputs while ensuring I use the notebook's exact random_state. For question one, I want to identify the "best accuracy of the hybrid filter wrapper strategy," which I believe is located in cell 22 under best_acc cross-val. So, I need to script accordingly to get everything lined up!

arguments.command:
cd /code && python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_selection import chi2, mutual_info_classif, SelectKBest
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, cross_val_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier

seg_data = pd.read_csv('../data/segmentation-all.csv')
y = seg_data.pop('Class').values
X_raw = seg_data.values
X_tr_raw, X_ts_raw, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X_raw, y, random_state=1, test_size=1/2)
scaler = MinMaxScaler()
X_train = scaler.fit_transform(X_tr_raw)
X_test = scaler.transform(X_ts_raw)
feature_names = seg_data.columns
chi2_score, pval = chi2(X_train, y_train)
chi2_score = np.nan_to_num(chi2_score)
i_scores = mutual_info_classif(X_train,y_train)
# highest info gain feature
idx = np.argmax(i_scores)
print('top_feature', feature_names[idx])
print('top_igain', i_scores[idx])
model = KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=3)
cv_acc_scores=[]; tst_acc_scores=[]; best_acc=0; best_k=0
for kk in range(1, X_train.shape[1]+1):
    FS_trans = SelectKBest(mutual_info_classif, k=kk).fit(X_train, y_train)
    X_tR_new = FS_trans.transform(X_train)
    X_tS_new = FS_trans.transform(X_test)
    cv_acc = cross_val_score(model, X_tR_new, y_train, cv=8)
    if cv_acc.mean() > best_acc:
        best_acc = cv_acc.mean(); best_k=kk
print('best_k',best_k,'best_acc',best_acc)
PY
